notes: Summary: evaluating Redwood Dedicated for inference at edge-control plane; primary concern is deterministic throughput + fast scale for bursts.
Workload profile: mix of short chat (avg 40 tokens), telemetry Q&A, and reranking slices. Typical sustained workload = 200 req/s, expected planned event bursts to 600-900 req/s for 20-90s windows.
Latency SLOs: target p95 <= 120ms for chat short responses, p99 <= 300ms; customer willing to accept slightly higher p99 during scheduled batch jobs (<= 1s).
Throughput guarantees: asking for committed baseline (guaranteed capacity) to cover 200 req/s with headroom for 2x sustained; want SLA credits if capacity not met during business-critical windows.

Reserved GPU planning: operations team prefers reserved pool equivalent to 8 x H100-class GPUs for baseline; request guidance on oversubscription, model sharding, and packing. Asked for Redwood capacity planner runbook and cost/benefit scenarios.

Autoscaling policy preferences: scale-up aggressive on queue depth + avg latency (trigger when queue > 25 requests OR avg latency > 80ms), warm-pool target 2 warm nodes per model variant, scale-up cooldown 30s (fast), scale-down cooldown 10m (avoid thrash).

Warm pools: want pre-warmed instances for model variants used in critical flows (control-plane prompts). Suggested warm pool sizing: 2 nodes per variant, 15-30s spin-up for extra nodes, option to pre-warm before scheduled events via API.
Queueing behavior: prefer bounded queue length (soft limit 500 requests) with backpressure responses above threshold; want observability on queue depth + per-request enqueue timestamp for debugging.

Burst handling: interested in Redwood burst credits / temporary burst capacity (2x baseline for 60s) vs permanent reserved expansion. Cost sensitivity: prefer burst credits to permanent over-provisioning.

SLA negotiation points: uptime 99.9% for control-plane, throughput SLOs with clear measurement window, credits for missed SLOs, escalation contact list, definitions for force-majeure and scheduled maintenance windows.
Security/compliance: require SSO/SAML, KMS for key management, audit logs retention 1 year, option for on-prem air-gapped appliance for safety-critical handling.
